run_inference_scenescript: run inference on a point cloud to generate a structured language sequence describing the scene
load_from_checkpoint: load a pretrained SceneScriptWrapper model from a checkpoint file with saved config and weights
preprocess_point_cloud: preprocess a raw point cloud by translating, normalizing, discretizing, and converting to a sparse tensor
top_p_nucleus_sampling: apply top-p nucleus sampling to filter logits for controlled autoregressive token generation
type_decoding_sequence: decode the next type token in an autoregressive sequence based on previous value and type tokens
